Plus and minus signs signify pressures acting toward and away from the internal surfaces, respectively.
Values of (GC_pi) shall be used with q_z or q_h as specified in Chapters 27 through 30.

Two cases shall be considered to determine the critical load requirements for the appropriate condition: (i) a positive value of (GC_pi) applied to all internal surfaces, and (ii) a negative value of (GC_pi) applied to all internal surfaces.
